description: Election Commission - D. A. S. Chaminda was selected as the member of the Walallawita P/S - M. Jeysankar was selected as the member of the Udapalatha P/S - W. I. Kumara was selected as the member of the Dimbulagala P/S
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) due to members ceasing to be party members or resigning. It involves the electoral process for local authorities under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, specifically addressing the nomination and declaration of new members to fill these vacancies. This falls directly under election-related administrative matters.
